meta.homeTitle: Screenshot (App) Maker — Izithombe ze-App Store, Zenziwe Kalula
meta.homeDescription: Yakha izithombe ze-App Store ezicwebile neziphelele zokuhambisa, bese usebenzisa i-Ollama ukukhiqiza izinhlobo ezihambisana nolimi lwendawo kalula.
meta.ollamaDescription: Xhumela i-Screenshot (App) Maker kuserver yakho ye-Ollama ukuze uthole ukuhumusha izithombe ngokusebenzisa i-AI eyimfihlo.
meta.privacyDescription: Funda ukuthi i-Screenshot (App) Maker igcina kanjani izithombe zakho, ukuhlela, nohlelo lokusebenza lokuhumusha kube yimfihlo.

language.title: Khetha ulimi
language.hint: Khetha ulimi oluzwakala lulula kakhulu kuwe. Amagama omkhiqizo nemiyalelo yezobuchwepheshe awushintshi.

hero.titleHtml: Shintsha izikrini ze-app zibe izithombe-sikrini ezilungele ukuhambiswa.
hero.description: Yakha zonke izithombe-sikrini ezidingeka ekuhambiseni i-app yakho, bese uxhumana no-Ollama ukuze udale izinhlobo ezihambisana nolimi lwendawo—ngaphandle kokuzenza kabusha ngesandla.

proof.title: Indawo eyodwa yokusebenza yobukiso
proof.body: Kusuka ezithombeni-skrini ezingakashintshwa kuya kwezinto ezicophelelayo

features.titleHtml:
Sebenzisa isikhathi esincane ekulungiseni.
Khipha imikhiqizo yakho ngokuzethemba okukhulu.
features.description: I-Screenshot (App) Maker ishintsha umsebenzi ophindaphindwayo ekupheleni kokukhipha i-app ibe yindlela eyodwa ecacile yokusebenza ebonakalayo.

cards.title: Faka izikrini zakho ze-app.
cards.body: Namukela ama-screenshot, uwabeke kuma-layout adizayiniwe wezinto zokusebenzisa, bese uhlela indaba ephelele ye-App Store ngemizuzu embalwa.

cards.title: Dizayina kanye kuphela.
cards.body: Faka imibala, ama-layout, izilungiselelo zezinto zokusebenzisa, uhlobo lobhalo, nemithunzi kuzo zonke ikhasi ngenkathi ugcina umlayezo ngamunye uyingqayizivele.

cards.title: Lungisa zonke izikrini.
cards.body: Lungiselela ama-asset e-iPhone, i-iPad, i-Apple Watch, i-Apple TV, kanye nezithombe ze-feature kusukela ohlelweni olulodwa.

cards.title: Khipha iphakheji elilungile lokuhambisa.
cards.body: Yakha izithombe ezisulu (high-resolution), hlela amafayela aqondiswe endaweni, bese uhlanganisa i-metadata ye-App Store ehunyushwe ibe yi-archive eyodwa ehlanzekile.

localization.title: Umkhankaso wakho we-screenshot, ulungile ukukhuluma zonke izimakethe.
localization.description: Xhumela i-Screenshot (App) Maker ku-Ollama bese uhumusha izihloko ze-screenshot kanye ne-metadata ye-App Store kulo workflow olulodwa. Uhlelo lwakho lokuqala luhlala lungashintshanga ngenkathi imibhalo ishintsha ngokwendawo ngasinye.
checks: Hhumusha imichaziso, amagama angukhiye, kanye nemininingwane yokukhishwa

workflow.title: Faka izikrini ezingashintshwanga. Khipha izinto ezilungile zestolo.
workflow.description: Alikho ukulungisa kwamansiseko okuyinkimbinkimbi. Akukho ukwakha kabusha i-campaign efanayo kuzo zonke izilimi.

steps.title: Geniza
steps.body: Yengeza izikrini ezichaza kangcono indaba yo-app yakho.

steps.title: Hlela nokuhumusha ngokwendawo
steps.body: Yakha ukubukeka kanye, bese uhumusha imibhalo yakho nge-Ollama.

steps.title: Khipha
steps.body: Landa izithombe ne-metadata ehlelekile, ezilungele ukuhambiswa.

privacy.title: Izinsiza ze-app yakho zihlala ngaphansi kokulawula kwakho.
privacy.description: Ukuhlela izithombe zesikrini kwenzeka kudivayisi yakho. Uma ukhetha i-Ollama, umbhalo uthumelwa kuphela kuleli kheli le-server olililungisile.

final.title: Yenza isinyathelo sokugcina sizizwe silula.
final.description: Hlela, hlukanisa ngokwendawo, futhi thumela zonke izithombe-skrini ezidingeka ekukhishweni kwakho kokulandelayo kwe-app.

ollama.title: Isifundo sokusetha i-Ollama
ollama.subtitle: Xhumela i-Screenshot (App) Maker ku-instance yakho ye-Ollama ukuze uthole ukuhumusha kwe-AI nokukhiqiza umbhalo.
requirements: I-Mac, i-Windows PC, noma imishini ye-Linux ukuze usebenzise i-Ollama
I-iPhone/iPad yakho kwinetwork efanayo neyemshini we-Ollama (kunconywa)
steps: Faka i-Ollama: landa ufake i-Ollama ku-OS yakho.
Qala i-Ollama: sebenzisa u-ollama serve (noma uvule i-app ye-Ollama ku-macOS).
Thola imodeli: sebenzisa u-ollama pull llama3.2 (noma imodeli oyikhethayo).
Qinisekisa ukuthi iyasebenza: sebenzisa u-ollama run llama3.2 bese uhlola i-prompt.
Thola ikheli lakho le-server: bhala phansi i-LAN IP ye-computer yakho (isib. 192.168.0.10).
Yisebenzise ku-app: kuzilungiselelo ze-Screenshot (App) Maker, beka i-Host kube ngu-http://<LAN-IP>:11434.
notes: Uma i-app ingakwazi ukuxhumana, qinisekisa ukuthi ifoni ne-computer yakho zise-network efanayo ye-Wi‑Fi.
Qinisekisa ukuthi i-port 11434 ivumeleke ku-firewall yakho.
Uma ukhetha ukusebenzisa i-remote server (i-PC yasekhaya, i-VPS), kumele uveze i-port ngokuphepha (kunconywa i-VPN).
ollama.ctaBody: Buyela ku-app, hlola ukuxhumana, bese uqala nge-locale eyodwa.

privacy.title: Inqubo yoBumfihlo
privacy.intro: Le Nqubo yoBumfihlo ichaza ukuthi i-Screenshot (App) Maker ("i-App") iphatha kanjani idatha yomsebenzisi.
summary: Azikho izakhawulo. Akukho ukuhlaziya. Akukho ukulandelela.
Amafayela akho nokuhlela kwakho kusala kudivayisi yakho ngaphandle kokuba ukhethe ukuxhumana neseva yakho ye-Ollama.
Uma usebenzisa i-Ollama, umbhalo uthumelwa kuphela kikheli leseva owulungisile.

sections.title: Ukuqoqwa Kolwazi
body: I-App ayiqoqi, ayigcini, noma ayithumeli imininingwane yomuntu siqu kuma-server ethu.
Izithombe zesikrini, ama-templates, nezithombe ezikhiphishwe zakhiwa futhi zigcinwe ngokwendawu kudivayisi yakho.

sections.title: Ukufinyelela emafailini nezithombe
body: I-App ingase icele ukufinyelela ohlelweni lweFiles noma kulayibrari yakho yezithombe ukuze ifake izithombe zesikrini.
Izithombe ezifakiwe zicutshungulwa kudivayisi futhi azithunyelwa phezulu ngokuzenzakalelayo.

sections.title: Ukuhumusha kwe-AI (Ollama)
body: Uma uvumela ukukhiqizwa kombhalo we-AI noma ukuhumusha, i-App ingathumela umbhalo ku-Ollama server oyilungisile (isibonelo, ikhompyutha yakho).
Asiphathi noma asitholi ithrafikhi yakho ye-Ollama, futhi i-App ayigcini noma ayigcini ngombhalo ocutshungulwe yi-AI.

sections.title: Izinsizakalo zezinhlangothi zesithathu
body: I-App ayisebenzisi ukuhlaziya kwezinhlangothi zesithathu, ama-SDK ezikhangiso, noma ezobuchwepheshe bokulandelela.

sections.title: Izinguquko
body: Singase sishintshe le Nkqubo Yeziimfihlo ngezikhathi ezithile. Izinguquko zizobonakala kuleli khasi.

sections.title: Ukuxhumana
body: Uma unemibuzo mayelana nale Policy Yokuvikela Imfihlo, sicela usithintele kuleli kheli le-imeyili elikhombisiwe ku-App Store.
